current_goal.goal: Confirm that AstrBot marketplace indexing reads metadata.yaml 0.1.33 from the default main branch and that a clean install from the repository root succeeds.
non_goals: Do not recreate a runtime publication branch or runtime-candidate branches.
Do not require a generated allow-list package for normal AstrBot marketplace distribution.
Do not claim marketplace refresh until it is externally observed.

active_validation_frontier.name: standard_astrbot_distribution
next_actions: Observe the AstrBot marketplace version after its next index refresh.
Perform a clean AstrBot install/update from the repository root URL.
Keep functional regression tests independent from marketplace packaging.
observed: AstrBot plugin collection validation normalizes plugin repositories to https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> and clones the default branch.
The maintainer's astrbot_plugin_sender_activation follows the same root-repository/default-main model.
The former custom runtime publisher failed because the generated candidate tree differed from runtime while both carried version 0.1.32.
0.1.33 restores the repository root URL and main branch as the installation/version truth and retires the custom runtime publisher workflows.

stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns plugin installation and marketplace repository cloning.
metadata.yaml and main.py live at the repository root on the default main branch.
The plugin adapts Volcengine request and media protocols without replacing AstrBot's plugin distribution model.
Functional CI may test compatibility, but CI must not introduce a second installation branch or version authority.
warning: 0.1.33 uses the standard AstrBot single-repository distribution model: main is both development and installation source; the historical runtime branch is not an active release authority.
